name: StepGrain
description: Live-capture granular pad for NTS-3. Touch freezes up to 3 s of AUDIO IN into a tempo-synced grain cloud. X/FEEL: sparse ↔ dense. Y = octave mix (0 / +1 / +2). Depth/MIX blends live input with grains (MODE: Volume or Freq). STEPS = body & grid; ENV = seam. SPRD / REVS.

params.name: FEEL
params.detail: Left: sparse one-grain stitches. Right: dense multi-grain wash

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Blend live input with grains. Volume: gain. Freq: crossover (LPF dry + HPF wet)

params.name: MODE
params.detail: Volume: gain mix. Freq: LPF on input + HPF on grains, then sum

params.name: STEPS
params.detail: Grain body length and trigger grid: 4 Bar, 2 Bar, 16 St, 8 St, 4 St, 2 St, 1 St, Half

params.name: ENV
params.detail: Fade-in/out seam beyond each STEPS body: Off, Half, 1 St, 2 St, 4 St, 8 St, 16 St

params.name: SPRD
params.detail: Random stereo width (0% = mono, 100% = hard L/R)

params.name: REVS
params.detail: Probability that a grain plays in reverse (0–100%)
